items_all.title: Open-source 3D-printed portable MRI machine built for under $70,000 — DIY medical equipment costs less than 7% of a full-sized MRI machine’s $1.1 million starting price
items_all.summary: This open-source project uses 3D printing to build the core of a portable MRI machine, although it still has a lower resolution compared to multi-million-dollar full-sized machines. One tech expert suggested that an AI model be trained on high-field MRI data or the physics of the actual machine to overcome this limitation.
items_all.title_original: Open-source 3D-printed portable MRI machine built for under $70,000 — DIY medical equipment costs less than 7% of a full-sized MRI machine’s $1.1 million starting price
items_all.title_en: Open-source 3D-printed portable MRI machine built for under $70,000 — DIY medical equipment costs less than 7% of a full-sized MRI machine’s $1.1 million starting price
items_all.title_bilingual: Open-source 3D-printed portable MRI machine built for under $70,000 — DIY medical equipment costs less than 7% of a full-sized MRI machine’s $1.1 million starting price
items_all.summary_zh: 这个开源项目使用 3D 打印来构建便携式 MRI 机器的核心，尽管与价值数百万美元的全尺寸机器相比，它的分辨率仍然较低。一位技术专家建议利用高场 MRI 数据或实际机器的物理原理来训练人工智能模型，以克服这一限制。

items_all.title: Chinese CXMT DRAM doesn't look like the budget savior many were expecting — new modules enter the market, but prices still track the big three
items_all.summary: Chinese retail listings indicate that CXMT-based memory modules are priced similarly to those featuring chips from the big three, despite expectations that they must be cheaper.
items_all.title_original: Chinese CXMT DRAM doesn't look like the budget savior many were expecting — new modules enter the market, but prices still track the big three
items_all.title_en: Chinese CXMT DRAM doesn't look like the budget savior many were expecting — new modules enter the market, but prices still track the big three
items_all.title_bilingual: Chinese CXMT DRAM doesn't look like the budget savior many were expecting — new modules enter the market, but prices still track the big three
items_all.summary_zh: 中国零售清单显示，基于长鑫存储的内存模块的价格与采用三大芯片的内存模块相似，尽管人们预计它们一定会更便宜。

items_all.summary: If you've been waiting for RX 9070 XT prices to fall, this $90 discount on XFX's triple-fan Quicksilver model is one of the best deals currently available.

items_all.title: Minecraft system requirements raised for the first time in 17 years — Microsoft now recommends 16GB of RAM and a 2020s or newer CPU to run the Java Edition
items_all.summary: Microsoft is increasing the minimum and recommended system requirements for Minecraft for the first time, 17 years after it launched. Although the system upgrade is quite reasonable and the hardware falls squarely within the most popular components in the most recent Steam Hardware Survey, those playing with a bare-minimum PC would have to upgrade their systems.
items_all.title_original: Minecraft system requirements raised for the first time in 17 years — Microsoft now recommends 16GB of RAM and a 2020s or newer CPU to run the Java Edition
items_all.title_en: Minecraft system requirements raised for the first time in 17 years — Microsoft now recommends 16GB of RAM and a 2020s or newer CPU to run the Java Edition
items_all.title_bilingual: Minecraft system requirements raised for the first time in 17 years — Microsoft now recommends 16GB of RAM and a 2020s or newer CPU to run the Java Edition
items_all.summary_zh: 在 Minecraft 推出 17 年后，微软首次提高了 Minecraft 的最低和推荐系统要求。尽管系统升级相当合理，并且硬件完全属于最近 Steam 硬件调查中最受欢迎的组件，但那些使用最低限度 PC 玩游戏的人还是必须升级他们的系统。

items_all.title: HP OmniBook X Flip 14 Review: Premium design, middling performance
items_all.summary: Though HP’s OmniBook X Flip 14 offers premium quality and features, rivals offer better display value or stronger performance for the money.
items_all.title_original: HP OmniBook X Flip 14 Review: Premium design, middling performance
items_all.title_en: HP OmniBook X Flip 14 Review: Premium design, middling performance
items_all.title_zh: HP OmniBook X Flip 14 评测：高级设计，中等性能
items_all.title_bilingual: HP OmniBook X Flip 14 评测：高级设计，中等性能 / HP OmniBook X Flip 14 Review: Premium design, middling performance
items_all.summary_zh: 尽管 HP OmniBook X Flip 14 提供优质的品质和功能，但竞争对手的性价比更高，具有更好的显示价值或更强的性能。

items_all.title: Zeiss expands German site that caps ASML's EUV scanner output — first new building opens four years after Oberkochen site groundbreaking
items_all.summary: Zeiss Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology has confirmed that it's adding around 25,000 square meters of production and production-adjacent space at Oberkochen in southern Germany.
items_all.title_original: Zeiss expands German site that caps ASML's EUV scanner output — first new building opens four years after Oberkochen site groundbreaking
items_all.title_en: Zeiss expands German site that caps ASML's EUV scanner output — first new building opens four years after Oberkochen site groundbreaking
items_all.title_bilingual: Zeiss expands German site that caps ASML's EUV scanner output — first new building opens four years after Oberkochen site groundbreaking
items_all.summary_zh: 蔡司半导体制造技术公司 (Zeiss Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology) 已确认将在德国南部的奥伯科亨 (Oberkochen) 增加约 25,000 平方米的生产及生产相邻空间。

items_all.title: AI enthusiast adds Nvidia Tesla V100 as loud as a lawnmower to gaming PC for $266 — 32GB of VRAM rig can run 27 billion parameter model at 32 tokens per second
items_all.summary: A computing enthusiast has repurposed a very noisy and largely obsolete enterprise GPU (with lots of VRAM) for local LLM inference purposes.
items_all.title_original: AI enthusiast adds Nvidia Tesla V100 as loud as a lawnmower to gaming PC for $266 — 32GB of VRAM rig can run 27 billion parameter model at 32 tokens per second
items_all.title_en: AI enthusiast adds Nvidia Tesla V100 as loud as a lawnmower to gaming PC for $266 — 32GB of VRAM rig can run 27 billion parameter model at 32 tokens per second
items_all.title_bilingual: AI enthusiast adds Nvidia Tesla V100 as loud as a lawnmower to gaming PC for $266 — 32GB of VRAM rig can run 27 billion parameter model at 32 tokens per second
items_all.summary_zh: 一位计算爱好者将一个非常嘈杂且基本过时的企业 GPU（带有大量 VRAM）重新用于本地 LLM 推理目的。
